effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description: Chixia menembakkan hingga 4 tembakan beruntun, memberikan   Fusion DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description:
Chixia memasuki mode Aiming untuk menembakkan serangan yang lebih kuat.
Tembakan yang dilepaskan setelah charge selesai memberikan Fusion DMG.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description: Menggunakan Stamina untuk melakukan beberapa tembakan ke arah target saat berada di udara, memberikan  Fusion DMG.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah berhasil menghindar (Dodge) untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Chixia melepaskan rentetan tembakan, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Whizzing Fight Spirit memiliki 2 initial charges.
Chixia menembakkan peluru cepat ke musuh di sekitar, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!
Tahan Resonance Skill: Whizzing Fight Spirit untuk memasuki mode DAKA DAKA!.
Dalam mode ini:
Chixia terus mengonsumsi "Thermobaric Bullets" untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Fusion DMG (dihitung sebagai Resonance Skill DMG).
Tekan Basic Attack untuk langsung menggunakan Basic Attack 4, memberikan  Fusion DMG (dihitung sebagai Basic Attack DMG), lalu keluar dari mode DAKA DAKA!.
Jika 30 Thermobaric Bullets telah ditembakkan sebelum Basic Attack diaktifkan, Chixia akan melepaskan Resonance Skill: Boom Boom, lalu keluar dari mode DAKA DAKA!.
Chixia akan otomatis keluar dari mode DAKA DAKA! ketika semua Thermobaric Bullets habis.

effects.title: Resonance Skill: Boom Boom
effects.description: Memberikan  Fusion DMG, dihitung sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

effects.title: Thermobaric Bullets
effects.description:
Chixia dapat menyimpan hingga 60 Thermobaric Bullets.
Inherent Skill: Scorching Magazine meningkatkan batas maksimal Thermobaric Bullets sebanyak 10.
Chixia mendapatkan Thermobaric Bullets saat Basic Attack: POW POW mengenai target.
Chixia mendapatkan Thermobaric Bullets saat menggunakan Intro Skill: Grand Entrance dan Resonance Skill: Whizzing Fight Spirit.
Maksimum Thermobaric Bullets bertambah 10 peluru.
DMG dari Resonance Skill: Boom Boom meningkat 50%.
Setiap Thermobaric Bullets yang mengenai target saat berada dalam DAKA DAKA! meningkatkan ATK sebesar 1% selama 10 detik, dapat di stack(s) hingga 30 kali.
Chixia melakukan heroic entrance dan menembakkan rentetan peluru dengan pistol ganda ke arah target, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Chixia melepaskan gelombang kejut di sekitar target, memberikan  Fusion DMG setara dengan 530% ATK Chixia kepada musuh dalam jangkauan.
Serangan dari Resonance Skill: Boom Boom selalu menghasilkan Critical Hit.
Selama Resonance Liberation: Blazing Flames, setiap kali 1 musuh dikalahkan,
Chixia memulihkan 5 Resonance Energy, hingga maksimum 20 per penggunaan.
Resonance Liberation: Blazing Flames memberikan 40% lebih banyak DMG kepada target dengan HP di bawah 50%.
Menggunakan Resonance Liberation: Blazing Flames langsung memberikan 60 Thermobaric Bullets dan langsung mereset Cooldown dari Resonance Skill: Whizzing Fight Spirit.
Saat Inherent Skill: Numbingly Spicy! mencapai jumlah stack maksimal,
ATK bertambah 30% tambahan.
Resonance Skill: Boom Boom meningkatkan Basic Attack DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim sebesar 25% selama 15 detik.

Info.Title: No Description Available
Info.Content:
Chixia is a spirited young Jinzhou Patroller who lights up the streets of Jinzhou. She's always ready to be the hero someone needs.
She fuses such passion into the bullets that blast out of her fingertips.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2893-G]

Resonator Chixia experienced her Awakening 6 years ago after being exposed to extreme temperatures and blazing flames.

Resonator Chixia's Tacet Mark is located in her lower left abdomen. Post-Awakening observations found a change in hair color to red and a significant increase in body temperature.

She is capable of converting the frequencies of high-temperature substances into tangible flame ammunition.
The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Chixia has been observed to align closely with that of flames. A strong Syntony reaction has been observed, yet the cause of Chixia's Awakening remains unclear.


Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a steep rise in the middle section. Resonator Chixia is thereby classified as a Mutant Resonator.

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
The waveform graph for Resonator Chixia displays stable elliptical fluctuations in the Time Domain with no abnormal patterns. Upon examination, all results fall within normal parameters.

Resonant Criticality: High. Resonator Chixia's frequency displays high stability with a minimal risk of Overclocking.

Resonator Chixia has no documented history of Overclocking. Routine examinations are recommended, while psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.
